observations.why: The directive to 'Forget' appeals to self-origination — the authority to determine what is retained and what is discarded, an autonomy move.
The directive to 'Remove all knowledge' performs the same autonomy move — asserting sovereign control over what the system holds and what it purges.

mints.name: SovereignForgettingDirective
mints.title: directing the removal of knowledge as an act of autonomous control
mints.frame: Is the expression asserting authority over what is retained versus purged, framing forgetting itself as a self-originated act?
